scope: Frozen production-route shadow modes; shared-host visual diagnostic only, no performance or motion verdict

mapping.albedo: linear vertex color times base-color factor and optional sRGB image
mapping.normal: four-weight posed tangent-frame normal maps with authored scale and handedness
mapping.orm: roughness/metallic factors times independently enabled data maps; authored AO strength
mapping.factionMask: explicit vertex factionMask, independent of color

productionSamplingProfile.source: GRASSFINE-L2D8 False Earth production profile: narrow curved mid blades plus zoom-aware near tier

standards.legibility: measured cloth-width floor from battle scene standardScale

readouts.depthPolicy: depth-disabled in-scene billboard; toneMapped=false (UI, ungraded); renderOrder after soldiers
readouts.orientation: camera-facing basis from the active three camera

gpuTelemetry.excludes: uploads, copies, queue wait and presentation; outside-submission work
